app.subtitle: Crypto confluence screener
ctl.alerts: {count, plural, =0 {No reversal alerts} one {# reversal alert} other {# reversal alerts}}
ctl.themeTo: Switch to {theme, select, light {light} other {dark}} theme
list.expandHint: Hide the controls so the asset list fills the screen
theme.label: Theme
scan.barHint: Signals are computed on this closed bar, not on the candle currently forming.
banner.stale: {n} symbols returned stale candles and were dropped from this scan. Signals shown are computed only from feeds that passed the freshness gate.
empty.title: No assets scanned yet for {customer}.
empty.body: Press Refresh to run the first scan. Signals use closed bars only.
status.storage: Storage: {kind, select, sqlite {native SQLite} indexeddb {browser IndexedDB} localstorage {browser localStorage} other {session only}}
status.disclaimer: Signals computed on closed bars · analysis tool, not financial advice
notice.bestEffort: This device may clear browser storage when space runs low. Export a backup regularly.
notice.session: Storage is blocked on this device. Your settings are kept only until you close the app. Export a backup before closing.
notice.backupDue: {days, plural, =0 {You have not exported a backup yet.} one {Last backup # day ago.} other {Last backup # days ago.}} Export one from About.
about.title: About
about.edition: Personal build — no licence key required
about.restoreConfirm: Restoring replaces your preferences and identity with the backup. Continue?
about.webglOff: 3D view unavailable on this device — showing the static mark.
wiz.title: Set up your terminal
wiz.workspaceHint: Shown in the header, the About dialog and exported file names.
wiz.logoBad: That file cannot be used as a logo. Use a PNG, JPEG or a plain SVG.
ac.sessionNote: The underlying market closes after hours and at weekends: token prices can drift from it and volume is thin. Treat signals on those bars with care.
scan.rateLimited: Exchange rate limit reached — scanning is paused for {s, number} s to protect your IP. Partial results are shown.
ledger.title: Signal ledger — forward test
ledger.intro: Every scored closed bar is recorded with the engine version. Outcomes enter at the next bar's open and include fees, slippage and funding.
ledger.configHelp: Engine identity: changes whenever the scoring engine changes, so results from different engines are never pooled.
ledger.cold: Left out (under {bars, number} bars of warm-up): {n, number}
ledger.empty: No signals recorded yet. Keep the scanner running: every closed bar adds rows for this source and timeframe.
ledger.pending: Outcomes appear once later bars have closed.
ledger.calibration: Score calibration (mean move by score band)
ledger.costs: Costs per side: {fee, number} bp fee + {slip, number} bp slippage; funding {funding, number} bp per 8 h on perpetuals.
ledger.notAdvice: Past outcomes do not predict future results; this is an analysis tool, not financial advice.
ledger.clearConfirm: Delete every recorded signal? This cannot be undone.
macro.upcoming: {event} in {hours, number} h — volatility is often higher around scheduled macro releases; how much that affects these signals is not yet measured.
macro.recent: {event} {hours, number} h ago — expect volatility to settle before trusting new signals.
ledger.otherEngines: Rows from other engine versions (kept, not pooled): {n, number}
ledger.closedExcluded: Underlying-closed bars left out of the statistics: {n, number}
ledger.storageBestEffort: Storage: best-effort (the browser may evict it)
ledger.exportNever: Never exported — export the ledger weekly.
ledger.exportDue: Last export {days, number} days ago — export the ledger weekly.
ledger.preregHelp: Fix the hypothesis now; the verdict is read only after at least {days, number} days.
ledger.preregStatus: Decision date {date} · horizon {h, number} bars. The hypothesis cannot be changed.
paper.title: Paper trading
paper.banner: Paper trading — simulated, no orders are sent
paper.intro: Practise the discipline the measurement gate asks for: STRONG score bands become practice proposals (not yet validated by the ledger), the risk engine checks each one, and only you can approve. Fills are simulated at the next bar's open with fees, slippage and funding.
paper.deadMan: No scan for over {bars, number} bars: approvals are blocked and open positions are unmanaged.
paper.costs: Simulated costs per side: {fee, number} bp fee + {slip, number} bp slippage; funding {funding, number} bp per 8 h on perpetuals.
paper.proposals: Practice proposals from STRONG score bands
paper.blockedAll: A lock is active: no proposal can be approved until it clears.
paper.noProposals: No strong BUY or SELL signal in the current scan.
paper.verdictPass: Risk check passed. If approved, it fills at the next bar's open.
paper.capped: Size reduced to fit the leverage cap.
paper.approvedMsg: Approved {name}: it fills at the next bar's open.
paper.err.nonce: The single-use code of this proposal does not match.
paper.err.expired: This proposal expired when the next bar closed.
paper.err.risk: The risk check failed at approval time.
paper.unmanaged: Unmanaged: no scan for over {bars, number} bars
paper.closeRequested: {name} closes at the next bar's open.
paper.gateProgress: Closed paper trades: {n, number} of the {total, number} needed before anything beyond paper is considered. Matching them to the recorded bars (reconciliation) is a separate step.
paper.killHelp: Blocks every new approval. Open positions are not closed automatically.
paper.killEngaged: Kill switch engaged: new approvals are blocked.
paper.killMismatch: Type {name} exactly to reset the kill switch.
paper.notAdvice: Simulated results are not real results. No order is ever sent to any exchange. This is not financial advice.
paper.rule.invalidInput: Price or ATR is missing or invalid.
paper.rule.maxPositions: Maximum number of open positions reached.
paper.rule.openRisk: This trade would exceed the open-risk cap.
paper.rule.cluster: Too many positions in the same cluster.
paper.rule.duplicate: A position on this pair is already open.
paper.rule.spotShort: Shorts on spot are turned off.
paper.rule.score: The score is below the minimum.
paper.rule.suppressed: The signal is suppressed (too little valid data).
paper.rule.sideMismatch: The side does not match the signal direction.
paper.rule.underlyingClosed: The underlying market was closed during the signal bar.
paper.rule.notional: No room left under the leverage cap.
ledger.refetched: History fetched for {n, number} pairs that left the scan
ledger.confirmatory: Gate uses rows recorded after pre-registration: {n, number}
update.hintIos: Install it with Sideloadly from the new iPhone build.
update.hintDesktop: Install it from the new installer.
update.hintAndroidLater: The Android package will follow shortly.
about.updatesNote: Reads one public file; nothing is sent.
health.label: {source} status
health.blockedHelp: The browser could not read this exchange and does not say why. Try again later, the installed app, or another source.
health.networkBlockedHelp: Your network or provider stopped the request. Choose another source.
ph.localMarket: ₱ Philippine peso market (Coins.ph) — much thinner than global USDT markets. Volumes are shown in US dollars.
ph.thin: {n, number} thin pairs under {floor}/day are not scored
ph.premiumHelp: Peso price against the global price at Coins.ph's USDT/PHP rate. Information only — it does not change the score.
about.dataNotice: Market data belongs to each exchange and is shown for personal use.
fx.stale: rates are more than 3 days old
depeg.note: {coin} trades {dev} from 1:1 against {ref} on this exchange — one of the two is off its peg. Information only; signals are unchanged.
ph.usdtPremium: USDT on Coins.ph is {dev} against the official peso rate.
paper.rule.currency: The paper account is in USDT: only pairs quoted in a USD stablecoin can be proposed.
fx.choose: Choose where exchange rates come from, update them, and check each source.
fx.customNotice: Not tested: this source is not on the tested list, so its rates are used exactly as you import them. To add it to the list, send a written request to the developer.
fx.customWhy: For your security the app only connects to the listed sources. Open your source in the browser, save its rates file (JSON), then import it here.
fx.customRequest: Send a written request to the developer
fx.customBad: This file has no exchange rates the app can read.
fx.src.ecb: derived from ECB euro reference rates
fx.displayOnly: Rates change only what is shown. Scores, the ledger and paper trading never use them.
paper.rule.drawdownLock: Drawdown lock reached: new trades are blocked until RESET.
paper.drawdownHelp: When equity falls {pct}% below its highest mark (open P&L included), new trades stop and every open trade closes at the next open of its own chart. Gaps and fees can take the loss past {pct}%. RESET keeps the loss and starts a fresh {pct}% from current equity.
paper.drawdownWaiting: Waiting for these charts to be scanned so their closes can fill: {series}
paper.drawdownConfirm: Type {name} to restart the drawdown limit from current equity
paper.drawdownMismatch: Type {name} exactly, after every lock close has filled.
paper.drawdownResetDone: Drawdown lock reset — a fresh limit starts from current equity.
paper.set.eventBlackout: Pause around FOMC, CPI and jobs reports
paper.set.locked: A loss lock or the kill switch is active — risk can't be loosened until the next UTC day after it clears
paper.rule.cryptoCap: Too many open crypto positions (crypto moves together).
paper.rule.depeg: The quote stablecoin is 1% or more off its peg against USDT.
paper.rule.intradayContext: 1m–15m signals are context only (allow them in risk settings).
paper.rule.event: Inside a macro event window (2 h before to 1 h after FOMC, CPI or jobs report).
paper.warn.riskAbove1: Risk per trade above 1% of equity — losing streaks compound fast.
paper.set.timeStopOn: Time stop (exit at the next open after the bars below; preset 24)
macro.coverage: {event} dates are only listed until {date} — update the app; the event blackout cannot cover later releases.
paper.tooFewTrades: Only {n} trades: too few to judge. Read these figures as noise until there are at least 30.
paper.rHistogram: Trades by R multiple (0.5 R bins)
pattern.title: Historical analogues (descriptive)
fvg.label: FVG adjustment (unvalidated)
pattern.badgeTip: {h}-bar historical mean: {move}. Similarity: {sim}%. Descriptive only — not a validated forecast.
pattern.disclaimer: Based only on earlier closed-bar analogues: it describes what similar past sequences did. A direction is shown only when the 95% lower bound of the hit rate beats the asset's base rate by more than 2 points. Not a forecast or financial advice.
ledger.power: Days needed at the current Sharpe (PSR 0.95): {days, number} in total · {remaining, number} beyond the blocks already logged. Small edges usually take years to confirm, not weeks.
ledger.powerNever: Days needed at the current Sharpe: no figure — the current Sharpe never reaches PSR 0.95. Confirming a small edge usually takes years, not weeks.
liq.help: Crypto pairs with less 24 h quote volume than this (in US dollars, valued at the quote's own price on the same exchange) are left out of the score. Display currency never changes it. Coins.ph peso pairs keep their own thin-pair rule.
liq.thin: {n, number} thin pairs under {floor}/day are not scored
reversal.clueNote: HIGH, MOD and LOW count net clues (three or more, two, one). They are not probabilities.
about.licencesNote: This app includes open-source software. Each component's licence and copyright notice is in the third-party notices.
about.trademarks: Bollinger Bands® is a registered trademark of John Bollinger. Exchange and token names and logos belong to their owners and only identify the market; no affiliation or endorsement.
row.updatingHint: Shown from the history on this device while its fresh data loads. Display only: not recorded, not proposed to the paper simulator, no alerts.
row.notUpdatedHint: This scan could not refresh this row; it shows the history on this device. Display only: not recorded, not proposed to the paper simulator, no alerts.
paper.heldFeedFailed: Bars could not be loaded for {list}. Their stops, targets and lock closes wait for those bars; the next scan tries again.
